body:
Customers can return most items within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging. Final-sale items, gift cards and personalised products cannot be returned.

To start a return, the customer opens the order page, selects "Return item" and prints the prepaid label. Returns are free for orders shipped within Vietnam. After the parcel reaches the warehouse, inspection takes up to 3 business days.

If the item arrived damaged, the customer should send a photo within 48 hours of delivery so the agent can create a damage claim instead of a normal return.
title: Return policy

body:
Refunds are issued after the returned item passes inspection. Card refunds take 5 to 10 business days to appear, depending on the bank. E-wallet refunds take 1 to 3 business days. Store-credit refunds are available immediately after approval.

Agents can check the refund status on the order page. If the refund was approved more than 10 business days ago and the customer still has not received it, escalate to Finance Ops with the order number. Agents must never ask the customer for full card details.
title: Refund timeline

body:
Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 business days in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and 3 to 6 business days in other provinces. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days in major cities.

Orders placed after 15:00 local time are processed on the next business day. Public holidays are not business days. A tracking number is sent by email once the parcel leaves the warehouse.

If a parcel has not moved for more than 3 business days, the agent opens a carrier investigation from the order page.
title: Delivery times

body:
Electronics sold by ShopNova carry a 12-month warranty from the delivery date. The warranty covers manufacturing defects. It does not cover accidental damage, water damage or normal wear.

To make a claim, the customer provides the order number, a short description of the fault and a photo or video. The agent creates a warranty case. The repair centre replies within 5 business days with a repair, replacement or refund decision.
title: Warranty claims

body:
An order can be changed or cancelled free of charge until it is packed. The order page shows the status "Packing" once this is no longer possible.

Address changes after packing require a carrier redirect request, which is not guaranteed. If an order cannot be cancelled, the customer can refuse delivery or use the normal return process after delivery.
title: Change or cancel an order

body:
Customers reset their password from the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

If the customer no longer has access to the registered email address, the agent must verify the account with the last order number and the delivery postcode before updating the email. Agents never send passwords and never ask for a one-time code.
title: Account access and password reset

body:
A failed payment does not create an order. A temporary authorisation may appear on the customer's statement and is released by the bank within 7 business days.

If the customer reports a double charge, the agent checks the order page for two paid orders. If only one order exists, the second amount is an authorisation hold. If two paid orders exist, the agent cancels the duplicate and the refund timeline in KB-002 applies. Never ask the customer to send card numbers in chat or email.
title: Payment failures and double charges

body:
Standard delivery is free for orders above 500,000 VND. Below that amount the standard fee is 30,000 VND. Express delivery costs 60,000 VND for all orders.

Shipping fees are refunded only when the whole order is returned because of a ShopNova error, such as a wrong or damaged item.
title: Shipping fees

body:
Gift cards are valid for 24 months from purchase and can be used for any product on ShopNova. They cannot be exchanged for cash or returned.

A lost gift card code can be re-sent to the purchaser's email address from the order page.
title: Gift cards
